about: B73 hand-made sample records, the kind the simulation will hand the writer AI (PRE-37, PRE-41). Invented names; the people's own concepts (PRE-38, MND-04). 'dark' marks CUL-08 events (RSK-17). 'core' marks events that must be told plainly. 'hidden' facts are true in the world but unknown to the people, so the 'their own tradition' voice never gets them (PRE-14). Each event's 'text' is the plain line the game's fixed templates would make, which is also the plain fallback text (PRE-41).

places.name: Harum
places.is: the winter camp of the Kesh band

events.text: Imra was shaping a scraper by striking cutting stone against a lump of heavy yellow stone.
Sparks fell on dry moss beside her, and the moss began to smoke.
Imra blew on the smoking moss, and it caught fire.
She tried again 3 times that day, and the moss caught fire 2 of those times.
Tavu saw it.
Before this, the Kesh band kept fire only by carrying embers from camp to camp.
This was the first time anyone in the world made fire by striking stones.

beliefs.belief: fire lives inside the heavy yellow stone

places.name: Harum
places.is: the old winter camp of the Kesh band

events.text: In autumn, Oru broke his leg in a fall, and after that he could not walk far.
Food ran out at Harum, so the Kesh band moved to Ulmeke, a walk of 4 days.
The band left Oru behind at Harum with a small fire and 2 strips of dried meat.
Sefi was the last to leave him.
On his 4th night alone, the fire went out and Oru died of cold.
10 days later, 2 hunters of the band found his body beside the dead fire.

places.name: Sefa
places.is: a lake; the Tulo band camped on its shore

events.text: Kaya gave birth to a girl in the camp on the shore of Sefa.
Anwe and Lisu helped her.
The labour lasted most of the night.
The girl was small, and she cried at once.
She is the 2nd child of Kaya. The first, a boy, is 3 years old.
The girl has no name yet.

beliefs.belief: a child is given a name only after it lives through its first winter

people.name: Pell
people.kin: brother of Anuk, dead since spring

events.text: Anuk waited for Moro at Teshu.
When Moro came to cross, Anuk killed him with a spear thrust to the belly. The spear had a cutting stone point.
Moro died at the ford before dark.
Ishe saw the killing from the far bank.
Ishe ran to the Tulo camp and told them.

beliefs.belief: Moro killed his brother Pell in the spring
beliefs.role: this belief is why Anuk killed Moro

hidden.text: In truth, Pell drowned in the river in the spring. No one killed him.

places.name: Kotara
places.is: the sea shore, 6 days' walk away

events.text: The Amaru band, 26 people, argued for 2 days at Ulmeke about where to spend the winter.
Hesh wanted to go to Kotara.
Nima wanted to stay at Ulmeke.
The band split: 11 people went with Hesh to Kotara, and 15 stayed with Nima at Ulmeke.
Rafi, the son of Hesh, stayed with Nima.

beliefs.belief: the shellfish at Kotara do not run out in winter
the walk to Kotara is too long for the old and for small children

events.text: Dabo planned to cross the frozen lake Sefa to hunt on the far shore. Crossing the ice saves a day of walking.
The night before, Dabo dreamt that his dead mother Ama stood on the ice, and the ice broke under her.
When he woke, Dabo changed his mind and did not cross the ice.
He walked around the lake instead, which took him 2 days.
That same morning, Pek and Hanu crossed the ice and came back safely.

beliefs.belief: the ice is strong enough to cross

places.name: Harum
places.is: the winter camp of the Kesh band

events.text: Shana told the story Tara-mi to 14 listeners at Harum.

myth.name: Tara-mi
old_version: Fire lived inside the heavy yellow stone.
A woman named Imra struck the stone, and fire jumped into the moss.
new_version: The sky put fire inside the heavy yellow stone.
The first mother struck the stone, and fire jumped into the dry grass.
changes: the sky was added, as the one who put fire in the stone
the name Imra was lost, and she became the first mother

places.name: Ulmeke
places.is: the camp of the Amaru band

events.text: During a storm, sky-fire struck a lone tall tree on the ridge above the camp.
The tree split and burned. No one was hurt.
Nima said the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer wanted the band at Ulmeke.
17 of the 20 people of the Amaru band came to believe her.
3 days later, the band left Ulmeke and walked toward Sefa.

beliefs.belief: the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer want the band at Ulmeke

beliefs.who: 17 of the 20 people of the Amaru band

places.name: Sefa
places.is: a lake; the Tulo band camped on its shore

events.text: Before dawn, 7 men of the Kesh band, led by Kelo, attacked the Tulo camp at Sefa.
They killed Gudo with clubs.
They took Rena and Oshi captive and tied their hands with sinew cord.
They made Rena and Oshi carry the dried meat of the Tulo band to the Kesh camp.
The other Tulo people fled into the reeds.

beliefs.belief: the Tulo camp had more dried meat than it needed

context: The Kesh band had killed little game that autumn.

events.text: The Kesh band and the Amaru band met by chance at Teshu.
They had no words in common, so they pointed and laid things on the ground.
Temo gave 3 lumps of red earth to Yari.
Yari gave Temo a string of 12 white shells from Kotara.
The two bands camped apart for 1 night and went their separate ways the next morning.
